exclusions.source_text: Participant with a known history or current symptoms of cardiac disease, or history of treatment with cardiotoxic agents, should have a clinical risk assessment of cardiac function of class 2B or better using the New York Heart Association Functional Classification.
Participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Participant has a corrected QT interval by Fridericia (QTcF) ≤ 470 msec.

Participant has had within 6 months prior to first dose of study intervention any of the following: unstable angina, myocardial infarction, ventricular arrhythmia requiring intervention or hospitalization for heart failure.

Participant is known to have human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection. However, participants with cluster of differentiation (CD) 4+ T cell counts ≥ 350 cells/µL and no history of acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) defining opportunistic infections within the past 6 months are eligible.
Participant has another malignancy for which treatment is required.

Female participant must not be breastfeeding or lactating starting at screening and throughout the investigational period and for 5 half-lives (6 months) after final ASP2138 intervention administration
